 ▝▝   ▝▝   ~/scratch/proj · /rc

  Updated: 7 features, 91 fixes, 32 other changes
  code.claude.com/docs/en/changelog for details


● Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically — Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and prompt injection before
  executing. Actions Claude identifies as safe are executed, while actions Claude identifies as risky are blocked and Claude may try a different
  approach. Ideal for long-running tasks. Claude can make mistakes that allow harmful commands to run, it's recommended to only use in isolated
  environments. Shift+Tab to change mode.
